welcome_message:
LEGO MLOps project template.
Answer a few prompts to scaffold an MLOps project with only the components you need.

data_product_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (valid Python package / Unity Catalog name).
data_product_name.description:
Data Product Name.
Used as the Python package, bundle name, model name, workspace folder, and resource identifiers throughout the project

schema.description: Unity Catalog schema for the project's output tables

include_ray.description: Include the Ray distributed-training path (adds a GPU job and the ray[tune] dependency)?

include_hyperparameter_tuning.description: Include a hyperparameter-tuning job (Ray Tune + Optuna)?

include_serving.description: Include a real-time model-serving endpoint task?

include_data_monitoring.description: Include a Databricks Lakehouse data-monitoring job?

success_message:
✨ Project '{{.data_product_name}}' created.

Next steps:
  cd {{.data_product_name}}
  uv sync --extra test && uv run pytest -q
  databricks bundle validate -t local --profile <your-profile>

Edit the example (anime score predictor) data-prep, training, and config to fit your data product.
